content.title: Arbe Robotics prices 11.5M shares at $1.40 in registered direct offering
content.summary: Arbe Robotics (ARBE) priced an underwritten offering of 11,500,000 ordinary shares at a purchase price of $1.40 per share. Arbe estimates the gross proceeds from this offering to be approximately $16.1M before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses.
